title: 特定交互操作生硬或受限
description: 部分交互操作如NPC互动、应答器使用、门锁操作等存在生硬感或限制，影响玩家与游戏世界的互动。
evidence:
If you uninstall your transponder it has an 80% chance to break, meaning you can't even dock at the home port anymore.
Even if you DO successfully uninstall it, it cannot be placed anywhere except your starting ship.
NPC interaction is still a bit janky
I NEVER FOUND A OPTION ALLOWED ME HUG MY CRUSH WHEN SHE TOLD ME HOLD HER

evidence_items.quote: очень не удобное управление. Интерфейс крайне недружелюбен. На первых порах вы даже характеристики персонажа посмотреть не сможете.
evidence_items.description: 控制非常不方便，界面极不友好，初期甚至无法查看角色属性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 非常不方便的操作。界面极其不友好。刚开始时你甚至无法查看角色的属性。

evidence_items.quote: I NEVER FOUND A OPTION ALLOWED ME HUG MY CRUSH WHEN SHE TOLD ME HOLD HER
evidence_items.description: 缺少拥抱等社交互动选项
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我从未找到一个选项，能让我在她对我说“抱住她”时拥抱我的心上人

evidence_items.quote: Диалоги стали НЕМНОГО приятнее в пользовании.
evidence_items.description: 对话使用体验略有改善
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话用起来变得稍微舒服了一点。

evidence_items.quote: Simple things could be improved about menus and NPC interaction
evidence_items.description: 菜单和NPC交互等简单方面可以改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 菜单和NPC互动这些简单的地方可以改进

evidence_items.quote: 20+ dialog options you have to scroll through is just so tedious and unnecessary
evidence_items.description: 对话选项过多，需要滚动浏览，非常繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 20多个对话选项还得滚动浏览，实在是太繁琐、太没必要了

evidence_items.quote: The flight interface is purposefully weird and impossible
evidence_items.description: 飞行界面故意设计得奇怪且难以操作。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行界面故意做得又怪又不可能操作

evidence_items.quote:
If you uninstall your transponder it has an 80% chance to break, meaning you can't even dock at the home port anymore.
Even if you DO successfully uninstall it, it cannot be placed anywhere except your starting ship.
evidence_items.description: 拆下应答器有80%概率损坏，且只能安装在起始船上，无法转移到其他船只
evidence_items.quote_zh:
如果你卸下你的应答器，它有80%的几率会损坏，这意味着你甚至再也无法在母港停靠了。
即使你确实成功卸下了它，它也只能被放在你的初始飞船上，除此之外哪里都放不了。

evidence_items.quote: lore and interaction with game elements lacks some polish (particularly with NPC's)
evidence_items.description: NPC交互和游戏元素缺乏打磨
evidence_items.quote_zh: 背景设定和与游戏元素的互动缺少一些打磨（尤其是与NPC的互动）

evidence_items.quote: NPC interaction is still a bit janky
I couldn't figure out how to lock a door or reset a code and a guy named Conner kept coming on board to steal my stuff
evidence_items.description: 无法弄清如何锁门或重置密码，导致名为Conner的人反复登船偷东西
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我搞不懂怎么锁门或重置密码，一个叫Conner的家伙老是上船来偷我的东西

evidence_items.quote: Docking procedure very unclear, I understood that one, you have to face the derelict with the tip of your ship even though your airlock is at the back... Once you know
evidence_items.description: 对接程序不清晰，需要面对残骸船头
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对接程序非常不清晰，我搞懂了那一个，你必须用你飞船的尖端面对废弃飞船，即使你的气闸在尾部……一旦你知道了
